description:
The organisation's audit value map: every domain (key, name, its
document, zone count), every active zone (slug, name, domain, verdict,
gain, star, last verified, its document) with its levers and their class
(quick_win, quick_action, waiting, project, long_term), the domain keys
zones use without a domain document, and the zone or domain documents
whose block could not be projected (with the error to fix).

Read zones and levers in full with myriade_audit_read_zones /
myriade_audit_read_levers, a zone's narrative with myriade_read_report
(the uuid inside <DOCUMENT:uuid>).
name: myriade_audit_list_map
